squidgame.game.final.instruction.1: Two finalists, one court shaped like a squid. A coin toss decides who attacks and who defends.
squidgame.game.final.instruction.2: ATTACKER: start in the square, fight your way up the neck and stand inside the golden circle of the head for %s s - or knock the defender out.
squidgame.game.final.instruction.3: DEFENDER: start in the triangle. Stop the attacker, push them over the white line, or survive until the clock runs out (%s).
squidgame.game.final.instruction.4: Touch or cross the white line, or lose all 100 health, and you are out. Everything you do costs stamina - an exhausted fighter cannot act.
squidgame.game.final.instruction.5: Left click: strike (hold to charge a heavy strike). Right click (hold): guard. %s or a double tap of A, D or S: dodge. %s: shove - little damage, but it breaks a guard and pushes your opponent towards the line.
squidgame.game.final.instruction.6: Difficulty: %s. Harder levels mean less stamina, harder hits and tighter dodge and parry windows.
squidgame.game.final.instruction.7: With more than two survivors the finalists fight a knockout ladder: the loser of every duel is eliminated and the last one standing wins.
squidgame.game.final.objective.spectator: Watch the duel from the gallery.
squidgame.game.final.objective.attacker: ATTACK: reach the golden circle and hold it - or knock them out!
squidgame.game.final.objective.defender: DEFEND: stop them, push them over the line, outlast the clock!
squidgame.game.final.objective.waiting: Wait in the gallery for your duel.
squidgame.game.final.chat.roles: The coin has landed: No. %s attacks, No. %s defends.
squidgame.game.final.chat.stakes: Touch the white line or lose all your health and you are out. The winner fights on.
